stemMd: A timetable gives departures at 08:10, 08:35, 09:05 and 09:40. A passenger arrives at 08:36. How long must the passenger wait for the next departure?
explanationMd: The 08:35 departure has just been missed, so the next is 09:05. From 08:36 to 09:00 is 24 minutes and then five more minutes gives 29. Use the arrival time, not simply the scheduled interval.

distractorRationale.a: This measures time since the previous departure.
distractorRationale.d: This is the interval between two departures, not the passenger’s wait.
distractorRationale.c: This is the first listed departure interval.
